card.name: Small words inside all-caps warning text
card.fires_on: Linking words like OF, AND and SHOULD in all-caps label headings and warnings, especially in lists and fixed section titles. Also fires on a few capitalised title words in reference lists.

modes.label: All-caps heading words
modes.description: OF or AND inside an all-caps section title or warning list.
modes.example: CARCINOGENESIS & MUTAGENESIS & IMPAIRMENT<< OF>> FERTILITY No carcinogenic effect of

modes.label: Emergency treatment lists
modes.description: AND before the last item in an all-caps list of emergency measures.
modes.example: OXYGEN, INTRAVENOUS STEROIDS<< AND>> AIRWAY MANAGEMENT, INCLUDING INTUBATION

modes.label: Titles in references
modes.description: A title word inside a book or article citation.
modes.example: The Other America:<< Poverty>> in the United States.

card.plain: It fires on little joining words in shouted all-caps label text, such as OF and AND in headings and warning lists.
